title: Esc in a cutscene or mini-game also opens the pause menu (and J opens the journal behind a mini-game)
details: (Found in the 2026-09-26 code review, owner asked for all of these to be fixed) Confirmed in the browser: the HUD scene keeps handling Esc/J/M/number keys/wheel while the world is paused for a cutscene or mini-game.
